header.title: Settings
header.description: Configure ProxMenux: toggle the Monitor service, reset its login credentials, switch between Stable and Beta in either direction, choose one of eight interface languages, inspect version diagnostics and uninstall. Monitor actions require its service to be installed; language selection is always available.

intro.title: What this menu is for
intro.body: Self-administration of ProxMenux itself: monitor service, beta channel opt-out, language, version diagnostics and the uninstaller. Nothing in this menu touches your VMs, containers or storage.

opening.heading: Opening the menu
opening.body: From ProxMenux's main menu, press <kbd>s</kbd>. Monitor actions appear when its service is installed; the remaining settings are always available:
opening.imageAlt: ProxMenux Settings menu with conditional Monitor actions

installTypes.heading: One installation, all languages
installTypes.intro: Current releases include static JSON translation catalogs in every installation. Older releases offered separate Translation and Normal modes:

rows.bundles: Static JSON catalogs for seven languages plus built-in English; no translation Python environment
Obsolete split between a translation environment and an English-only installation
rows.menu: Update with the official installer to use the current unified menu

installTypes.detectionBody: The menu no longer checks for a translation environment. Every installation includes /usr/local/share/proxmenux/lang/ and saves the selected language in config.json.

options.heading: Menu options
options.intro: The tools below manage ProxMenux itself. Conditional means the Monitor actions appear only when its systemd service is installed. Release channel, language, version diagnostics and uninstall are always available.

list.title: ProxMenux Monitor
list.description: Activate / deactivate the proxmenux-monitor.service systemd unit, check its current state, and reset the dashboard login password if it's been lost. Web UI available on TCP 8008.

list.title: Change Release Channel
list.description: Switch between Stable (main) and Beta (develop) in either direction from a single dialog. Runs the official installer for the chosen channel; idempotent and always visible.

list.title: Show Version Information
list.description: ProxMenux version, release channel, installed components, file paths, translation files and current language.

list.title: Uninstall ProxMenux
list.description: Remove ProxMenux and (optionally) its dependencies. Also restores /root/.bashrc and /etc/motd backups created at install time.

configTip.title: Where the config lives
configTip.bodyRich: Most state managed by this menu lives in /usr/local/share/proxmenux/config.json — language, beta_program.status and per-component install flags. The Monitor service's state lives in systemd (proxmenux-monitor.service), not here. Version is read from /usr/local/share/proxmenux/version.txt.
